jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: DFGSim's red human fighter. Input image 2 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: DFGSim's Huwawa. Match their approachable cartoon language: very thick dark brown-black outlines, large simple geometric forms, broad flat color fills, at most one or two simple shadow tones, no texture or tiny detail. NOT photorealistic, NOT painterly, no brush texture, no thin-line intricate art, no gradients. Asset type: complete game overworld ground map, landscape 3:2 composition approximately 1536 by 1024. Primary request: a cheerful mythological Sumerian village and surrounding countryside, viewed nearly TOP DOWN with a little three-quarter roof visibility, like a hand-drawn cartoon exploration RPG. Entire rectangular canvas is a continuous traversable map, no sky, horizon or distant camera perspective. Small buildings and landmarks separated by VERY BROAD CONNECTED open sandy footpaths and large empty sandy plazas for separately overlaid moving game characters. No people, creatures, enemies, text, letters, signs with writing, UI, gridlines, or borders. Spatial layout is important: BOTTOM LEFT a cozy small mud-brick sanctuary/home with a blue doorway and a chunky stone mailbox beside its entrance; MIDDLE LEFT a tiny open market with two orange/cream awning stalls and stacks of plain clay tablets; UPPER LEFT a compact cedar grove with an open sandy clearing in front; UPPER MIDDLE a flat round raised training terrace with shallow stairs facing down; LOWER MIDDLE a canal garden with a short horizontal wooden bridge across turquoise water; RIGHT THIRD a monumental but compact stepped ochre temple and generous open sandy Bull of Heaven court in front. Left and center walkable roads connect the home, market, grove clearing, terrace, canal bridge, and temple court; make these easy to follow and mostly straight, at least a sixth of canvas height wide in places. Place buildings behind or beside paths, not in front of them. Simple green reeds, a few date palms, rounded rocks, cropped field strips, and sparse little clumps of grass along outer edges. Warm sand, terracotta mud brick, muted olive foliage, turquoise canal, small blue accents, thick cartoon outlines. Keep object scale consistent, no dramatic large foreground objects, no floating islands. Empty gentle welcoming adventure map, not a decorative map poster.
